name: aircraft-sky-tracker
description: Local Aircraft Sky Tracker - an exceptionally simple real-time view of aircraft near a configured UK postcode.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ast/shared && npm run build -w @ast/server && npm run build -w @ast/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ast/shared && npm run test -w @ast/server
